meta.title: "Fill struct fields" assist shouldn't be applicable if the struct has inaccesible fields
meta.fix_ref: rust-lang/rust-analyzer#21977 (fix: Disable the fix for missing-fields when the fields are private)
meta.build_notes: GitHub release assets rust-analyzer-aarch64-apple-darwin.gz of the weekly tags 2026-04-06 and 2026-04-13; git tag --contains puts the fix first in 2026-04-13. The sysroot is the local rustup toolchain (rustc 1.98.1).
meta.notes: The missing-fields fix filled every field of the aliased struct Rc<Struct>, including its private fields ptr and phantom (alloc's fields at the time of the report; the local std names them the same or similarly); the fix no longer offers it when a field is not visible. Attempt 1 (diagnostics after the edit) could not see it: rust-analyzer does not diagnose private fields in struct literals. Attempt 2 uses the specification probe with the expectation of the issue and the fix's regression test (no fix).

settings_note: The issue names no settings; the session keeps checkOnSave off (native analysis only).

files.note: a binary crate around the snippet (package name, version, edition 2021)

repro.steps: Open src/main.rs. 'let data = Data {};' (Data = Rc<Struct>) is reported for missing fields. Apply the fix 'Fill struct fields'. Reported: 'Data { ptr: todo!(), phantom: todo!() }', whose fields are private (E0451); expected: no such fix. Probe (specification, attempt 2): the fix must not be offered (the fix's regression test is check_no_fix), i.e. the text must stay unchanged: an offered fix that changes the text is present, no fix offered is absent.

expected.source: issue title ('Fill struct fields' assist shouldn't be applicable if the struct has inaccessible fields) and the fix's regression test inaccessible_fields (crates/ide-diagnostics/src/handlers/missing_fields.rs@7d23c32b, check_no_fix): no fix, so the text stays unchanged

attempts.summary: Fill struct fields checked with a fresh session on the edited text: not-reproduced-pre. The pre build 2026-04-06 offered the fix and filled the private fields of the local std's Rc ('Data { ptr: todo!(), phantom: std::marker::PhantomData, alloc: std::alloc::Global }'), the reported behavior, but rust-analyzer reports no error for private fields in a struct literal (rustc: E0451), so the diagnostic probe saw nothing new; the post build 2026-04-13 offered no fix (0/3 each).
